How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
Using your Battery Tender® Plus 12V 1.25 Amp IP65 is simple and straight to the point:
1. Permanent Installation (Recommended): Attach the ring terminal harness directly to your battery posts (red to positive, black to negative). Leave the quick-disconnect plug easily accessible so you can plug the charger in without taking off covers or popping seats.
2. Connect First, Then Power On: Connect the charger to the quick-disconnect harness before plugging the charger into an AC wall outlet. The spark-proof circuitry ensures no electricity flows until a secure connection is made.
